statement: A probe COPY plus owned helpers were prepared and CPU-self-tested. NOTHING was run against a browser, a GPU or the game. No earned Continue has been tested; no claim of readiness for any capture result is made here.

boundSource.previewObservedDuringPrep: http://127.0.0.1:38007/ (root-owned, never started or stopped by this role)
boundSource.runtimeUrlBinding: --url is compared to whatever preview-ownership.json publishes at actual release; no port is hardcoded in the probe.

pin.why: The manual COMMON role owns commonPassageLogic.mjs and edited it at 16:25:52Z during this prep window; the earned lane imports the PINNED byte copy, never the live file.

selfTests.expected: served bytes fetched and bound, then refused on the two root-controlled prerequisites
remainingRefusals: exclusive shared heavy lock not provably held (no inherited fd)

preparedRuntimeCommand.note: PREPARED ONLY — do not run while the manual COMMON role is active. The shared lock is acquired by the INVOKER and inherited on fd 9; the probe never opens it.
preparedRuntimeCommand.shell:
exec 9>>/home/thomasphillip/Projects/Paraform/harness/output/.heavy.lock
flock -n -x 9 || { echo 'heavy lock busy'; exit 1; }
URL=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('verifier/artifacts/preview-ownership.json'))['url'])")
node verifier/probes/earned-continue/earned-continue-probe.mjs \
  --out earned-continue-1 \
  --url "$URL" \
  --expect-source-manifest dc63fbaeacea44166f41b4d9307bc2e31307fc28845c69512f75c7d641adc36c \
  --heavy-lock /home/thomasphillip/Projects/Paraform/harness/output/.heavy.lock \
  --heavy-lock-fd 9 \
  --role earned-continue \
  --min-samples 4 --return-ms 180000 --earn-ms 120000 --walk-ms 90000

flags.--url: required, must equal root-published preview url
flags.--expect-source-manifest: required, must equal the live manifest file hash
flags.--heavy-lock-fd: inherited descriptor (9) of an ALREADY-acquired exclusive flock

lanePlan.does: root readiness + control action/activeRole + inherited exclusive flock receipt + ACTUAL served index/bundle byte hashes + dynamic 99-file source rehash + non-empty capture refusal; writes preflight.json then throws PREFLIGHT-REFUSED if anything is unbound.

?story=ch13-return&journeyprobe=1&debug=1&movie=1 (labelled INITIAL prerequisite fixture; NO preseeded origin-landed). Watches the movie-scripted physical flight, sampling beat/objective/world/fired anchors and the NAMED signedSceneAv anchorId+activationSequence+history as a time series.

earnedOriginGate: story:ch13-origin-landed latched, live activePlanetId handed off from the departure body, locationMode=surface, controlMode=fps, grounded supported=true with a finite bodyPose, a live rAF-measured frame rate >= --min-fps, and NON-EMPTY NAMED AV anchor history. FAILURE STOPS THE LANE before any drawing, save, Continue or [F].

movie rail plus ORDINARY shipped WASD bursts (labelled scripted-input) until >=4 real samples in phase=drawing; checkpointPurity CATCHES the capture at once and refuses if route-offered/route-tested already fired.
same-tab navigation fires App.tsx beforeunload -> doSave(true) -> saveWorld/saveGlobal; the ACTUAL per-world and global localStorage bytes are copied out to files BEFORE the browser closes.

plain boot with NO story deep link and no movie rail (continueBootDecision proves it), storage retained (key set compared), then a real click on the landing CTA -> LandingMenu.startOrContinueStory -> beginStory -> storyEntryPoint. The menu label alone is never treated as proof.

worldIdentityVerdict (storage key prefix, world id, seed, live activePlanetId at save vs after Continue, actor milestones), overwriteVerdict (earned samples still on disk), replayVerdict (no already-earned anchor re-activated, no pending re-queue, installWatch unchanged) and an AV delta across the boundary.

ordinary WASD to the remaining drawing end E, then [F] ONLY when the shipped primary prompt literally offers it (newActionGate); acceptance is read as NEWLY FIRED NAMED anchors and an advanced AV activation sequence (newAnchorEligibility).
owned session try/finally + post-finally receipt, root preview never stopped, dynamic source rehash AFTER the capture written to source-rehash.json.

divergencesFromCopiedParent: entry changed from ?story=ch13-survey to ?story=ch13-return with an earned-origin gate (the survey deep link cannot seed story:ch13-origin-landed, which is why run-5 resumed at the departure body)
the parent's walk-to-W 'earn the landing after Continue' rescue branch was REMOVED: in this lane a resume anywhere but ch13-survey on the same body is the measurement, not something to walk around
the parent's secondary Pause -> Quit-to-Menu phase was REMOVED because its fallback used a Playwright FORCED click
[F] is now gated on the shipped primary prompt instead of pressed unconditionally

AV is read as the nested NAMED signedSceneAv object (anchorId / anchorEvent / activationSequence / activationHistoryAnchorIds) sampled over time; the raw Object.keys count used by the flight lane is retained only as rawKeyCountIsNotEvidence
commonGround diagnostic reads keep the NESTED paths and add installWatch; the flat s.anchors path used by the flight lane measured null
preflight, capture-dir refusal, served-byte binding, heavy-lock receipt, live FPS and dynamic before/after source rehash added
finding ids renamed PC-* -> EC-* so this lane's findings can never be confused with the preserved partial-continue evidence

evidenceReadDuringPrep.used: run-5 findings PC-SAVE-OVERWRITTEN / PC-CONTINUE-RESUME-POINT, the saved -1,-1 vs restored -1,-1:p1 world split, and the fixture-incompleteness limitation
flight lane conclusion (Origin envelope entered then departure reset, originLanded false) and the manual lane's fixture/report qualifications

the 73 791 ms earned landing on this same frozen source/preview: beat ch13-survey, objective ch13:survey:start, activePlanetId handoff -1,-1:p1 -> -1,-1. This is the prerequisite that unblocks the lane; it is NOT this lane's result.

remainingLiveSteps: root must publish activeRole=earned-continue (or an equivalent slot) in verifier-control.json; today it is common-manual-focused and the probe refuses
the invoker must acquire the exclusive shared flock and pass it in on fd 9; the probe opens no lock
--url and --expect-source-manifest must be taken from whatever root publishes AT ACTUAL RELEASE, not from the values observed during this prep
one headed run on the NVIDIA GB10 with a fresh --out; every phase above is unexecuted
knownLimitations: NOTHING here is a capture result: no earned Continue has been tested and no restoration, no-overwrite, no-replay or new-anchor claim is made
the ch13-return deep link remains a labelled PREREQUISITE FIXTURE; this lane proves nothing about a continuous station/home journey into ch13
the movie rail is scripted input; the flight is not evidence of unassisted play, and any ordinary WASD assistance is labelled scripted-input in the report
flight-1 landed in 73.8 s once; the earlier earned-1/earned-2 lanes did not land at all, so --return-ms 180000 may still expire and stop the lane at the gate
the earn phase inherits the known VF4-SURVEY-STALL-1 rail stall and hands over to ordinary keys after 15 s of no growth
live FPS is measured with a passive rAF counter, not __game.metrics(): adding ?agent=1 would install the scriptable AgentCamera bridge and change what draws
previewBindingDecision compares the served index and the ONE published bundle plus root's matched-file COUNT; the remaining built files are unmeasured
if the manual COMMON role edits commonPassageLogic.mjs again, this lane keeps the PINNED bytes; a future re-pin is a deliberate act with a new pin.json
unresolvedIssues: BLOCKING: the lane cannot run at all until root grants the active role and the inherited heavy lock (both refusals are live right now).

UNKNOWN: whether the shipped resume ladder lands an earned save in ch13-survey at all. run-5 showed a lawful resume into ch13-return on the sibling body when origin-landed was absent; with the milestone present the resume point is untested and the lane may legitimately stop at EC-CONTINUE-RESUME-POINT.

UNKNOWN: whether the shipped save writes the earned survey samples for the Origin world key when the drawing is earned after a real flight; run-5's PC-SAVE-OVERWRITTEN was observed with the incomplete fixture and must not be assumed to transfer.

UNVERIFIED-BY-ME: the exact target coordinate E = [-42, 51.05, 12] is inherited from the parent probe; I did not re-derive it from the current authored route, and a wrong end point would surface as a walk that never arrives rather than as a false pass.
